arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('t_lookup.py').read()
lines=s.split('\n')
out=[]
for ln in lines:
    if ln.strip().startswith('# verify with independent LPM'):
        continue
    out.append(ln)
s='\n'.join(out)
s=s.replace("        # verify with independent LPM using main.parse_addr\n","")
open('t_lookup.py','w').write(s)
EOF
sed -n '95,110p' /app/tmp/t_lookup.py
